import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static final char NEWLINE = '\n';
    static final long INF = 0x3f3f3f3fL;
    static final long INFLL = 0x3f3f3f3f3f3f3f3fL;
    static final long MOD = 1000000007L;
    static final double EPS = 1e-10;
    static final int MAX_TIME = 99;
    static final int MAX_C = 12;

    static class Edge {
        int to, reverse;
        long flow, capacity, cost;

        Edge(int to, int reverse, long flow, long capacity, long cost) {
            this.to = to;
            this.reverse = reverse;
            this.flow = flow;
            this.capacity = capacity;
            this.cost = cost;
        }
    }

    static Edge[][] graph = new Edge[5000][];
    static int[] degree = new int[5000];
    static long minCostAccumulated;

    static void initializeGraph(int n) {
        minCostAccumulated = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
            degree[i] = 0;
            graph[i] = new Edge[0];
        }
    }

    static void addConnection(int u, int v, long cap, long cost) {
        minCostAccumulated = Math.max(minCostAccumulated, cap);
        graph[u] = growArray(graph[u], degree[u] + 1);
        graph[u][degree[u]] = new Edge(v, degree[v], 0, cap, cost);
        degree[u]++;

        graph[v] = growArray(graph[v], degree[v] + 1);
        graph[v][degree[v]] = new Edge(u, degree[u] - 1, 0, 0, -cost);
        degree[v]++;
    }

    static Edge[] growArray(Edge[] arr, int newSize) {
        Edge[] newArr = new Edge[newSize];
        if (arr != null) {
            System.arraycopy(arr, 0, newArr, 0, Math.min(arr.length, newSize));
        }
        return newArr;
    }

    static boolean[] visitedNodes = new boolean[5000];
    static int[] parentNodes = new int[5000];
    static long[] potential = new long[5000];
    static long[] distances = new long[5000];

    static void initializePotential(int n) {
        Arrays.fill(potential, 0, n, 0);
        for (int step = 1; step < n; ++step) {
            for (int node = 0; node < n; ++node) {
                if (graph[node] != null) {
                    for (Edge e : graph[node]) {
                        if (e.capacity > 0) {
                            potential[e.to] = Math.min(potential[e.to], potential[node] + e.cost);
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    static long augmentPath(int source, int sink, long[] totalCost, int nodeCount, boolean useQueue) {
        Arrays.fill(visitedNodes, 0, nodeCount, false);
        Arrays.fill(distances, 0, nodeCount, INF);
        distances[source] = 0;

        if (useQueue) {
            Queue<Integer> q = new LinkedList<>();
            q.add(source);
            while (!q.isEmpty()) {
                int u = q.poll();
                if (visitedNodes[u]) continue;
                visitedNodes[u] = true;
                if (graph[u] != null) {
                    for (Edge e : graph[u]) {
                        if (e.flow < e.capacity && distances[e.to] > distances[u] + potential[u] - potential[e.to] + e.cost) {
                            distances[e.to] = distances[u] + potential[u] - potential[e.to] + e.cost;
                            parentNodes[e.to] = e.reverse;
                            q.add(e.to);
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        } else {
            for (int u = source; u != -1; ) {
                visitedNodes[u] = true;
                if (graph[u] != null) {
                    for (Edge e : graph[u]) {
                        if (e.flow < e.capacity && distances[e.to] > distances[u] + potential[u] - potential[e.to] + e.cost) {
                            distances[e.to] = distances[u] + potential[u] - potential[e.to] + e.cost;
                            parentNodes[e.to] = e.reverse;
                        }
                    }
                }
                u = -1;
                long best = INF;
                for (int i = 0; i < nodeCount; ++i) {
                    if (!visitedNodes[i] && distances[i] < best) {
                        best = distances[i];
                        u = i;
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        if (distances[sink] >= INF) return 0;

        long bottleneck = INF;
        for (int node = sink; node != source; ) {
            Edge revEdge = graph[node][parentNodes[node]];
            Edge forwardEdge = graph[revEdge.to][revEdge.reverse];
            bottleneck = Math.min(bottleneck, forwardEdge.capacity - forwardEdge.flow);
            node = revEdge.to;
        }

        for (int node = sink; node != source; ) {
            Edge revEdge = graph[node][parentNodes[node]];
            Edge forwardEdge = graph[revEdge.to][revEdge.reverse];
            forwardEdge.flow += bottleneck;
            revEdge.flow -= bottleneck;
            totalCost[0] += bottleneck * forwardEdge.cost;
            node = revEdge.to;
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < nodeCount; ++i) {
            potential[i] = Math.min(INF, distances[i] + potential[i]);
        }
        return bottleneck;
    }

    static long computeMinCostMaxFlow(int source, int sink, long[] totalCost, int nodeCount, boolean useQueue) {
        initializePotential(nodeCount);
        long totalFlow = 0;
        totalCost[0] = 0;
        while (true) {
            long df = augmentPath(source, sink, totalCost, nodeCount, useQueue);
            if (df == 0) break;
            totalFlow += df;
        }
        return totalFlow;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws Exception {
        System.setIn(new ByteArrayInputStream(System.getProperty("input", "").getBytes()));
        System.setOut(new PrintStream(new ByteArrayOutputStream()));
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        String[] line = br.readLine().split(" ");
        int n = Integer.parseInt(line[0]);
        int m = Integer.parseInt(line[1]);
        int k = Integer.parseInt(line[2]);
        int c = Integer.parseInt(line[3]);
        int d = Integer.parseInt(line[4]);

        final int sourceNode = 0;
        final int sinkNode = n * MAX_TIME + 1;

        initializeGraph(sinkNode + 1);

        for (int i = 0; i < k; ++i) {
            int a = Integer.parseInt(br.readLine());
            addConnection(sourceNode, a, 1, 0);
        }

        for (int t = 0; t < MAX_TIME; ++t) {
            addConnection(1 + t * n, sinkNode, INF, 0);
            if (t > 0) {
                for (int i = 1; i <= n; ++i) {
                    addConnection(i + (t - 1) * n, i + t * n, INF, c);
                }
            }
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < m; ++i) {
            String[] edge = br.readLine().split(" ");
            int a = Integer.parseInt(edge[0]);
            int b = Integer.parseInt(edge[1]);
            for (int j = 0; j < MAX_C; ++j) {
                int cost = (j + 1) * (j + 1) - j * j;
                for (int t = 1; t < MAX_TIME; ++t) {
                    addConnection(a + (t - 1) * n, b + t * n, 1, (long) cost * d + c);
                    addConnection(b + (t - 1) * n, a + t * n, 1, (long) cost * d + c);
                }
            }
        }

        long[] totalCost = new long[1];
        long flow = computeMinCostMaxFlow(sourceNode, sinkNode, totalCost, sinkNode + 1, true);
        System.out.println(totalCost[0]);
    }
}
